aiSummary: The Cambridge Postgraduate Funding system provides fully funded, partially funded, and self-funded opportunities for incoming Master's and PhD students at the University of Cambridge. Most University scholarships are applied for directly through the course application in the Applicant Portal by ticking 'Yes - I wish to apply for funding' before the course funding deadline. Main University funding deadlines for 2027/28 entry are 8 December 2026 and 6 January 2027 (with US citizens applying for Gates Cambridge having a deadline of 14 October 2026). Funding offers are generally made separately from admission offers, with peak funding awarding occurring between March and April.
